reviews.title: Reliable high capacity storage
reviews.comment: This is a reliable SATA drive providing high capacity storage in a 2.5 inch drive. It provides respectable speeds for a wide range of file types. I am using this to catalog 100 years of family photos that I have been painstakingly digitizing. When you run out of NVMe slots, most computers still have SATA ports you can make use of. This drive is an excellent choice for one of those ports. I highly recommend it.
reviews.author: prof2000

reviews.title: WD - Blue SA510 rTB Internal SSD Sata
reviews.comment:
I installed the WD Blue SA510 yesterday.  I moved over 2.5TB from an external hard drive to this new SSD.  Once completed, I was amazed at the speed of opening videos as well as editing videos.  I also edit photos with Affinity Photo 2.5 with no issues.  Extremely happy with the product.  

On the negative side, this product was delivered to my house.  The product arrived in the city at 8:37 a.m. and was out for delivery at 10:33 a.m.  The product arrived at 8:16 p.m.  This is not Kool because the carrier ruined my whole day as I waited for the product to arrive.  USPS is the most reliable carrier to deliver products.  USPS delivers to your mail box and you know when your mail carrier will arrive with your product.  The other three carrier are questionable.
reviews.author: BobbyO
